0: Stone underfoot. Scent on the air. Both, at once.
Followed fresh tracks into a mine entrance.
Dig site and old bones together. Someone was here before.
The cave had teeth marks on the walls. Not from tools.
Something living down here. Also ore. Not unrelated.
Hunting in a place where the ore is also worth taking. Two trails at once.
Tracks and tunnel both leading down. Followed both.
Tunnel mouth with old bones at the entrance. The new bones were elsewhere.
Smell of iron and game in the same passage. Worked both.
Stone scarred by claws and by tools. Could not tell which was older.

light: Pickaxe in one paw, eye on the dark. Difficult.
Interrupted mid-dig by something that disagreed.
The scent changed. Stopped digging. Waited.
Loose stone slipped while I was tracking. The track survived. Mostly.
Cornered by something that turned out to be a bat. The bat won the argument briefly.
Tunnel narrowed where the chase had wanted room. Adjusted.
Lost the trail in the dust. Found it on the next wall.
Stopped mid-cut to listen. Something there. Something not there.
moderate: Mob cornered me mid-seam. Had to stop the work.
Swung at stone, hit something else instead.
Too deep to run. Had to fight instead.
Took a hit while the pickaxe was still in the wall. Pulled it out. Worked both jobs.
Prey turned around in the tunnel. Then the prey was behind me.
Tunnel collapsed where I had just been hunting. The hunt found a different shape.
Something fast in a place where I was slow. Got faster.
Quarry pinned itself in a side-passage. The side-passage gave me trouble too.
severe: Everything at once. Stone, mob, darkness. Got through it.
The tunnel filled with them. Left fast.
Cornered in the deep. Dug another way out.
Pack and pickaxe both, all at once. Came out lighter. Came out.
Ceiling came down between me and the prey. Came down on neither of us.
Trapped between the seam and the snarl. Made a third option.
Bad day in two professions at once. Came home anyway.
Lost the trail, lost the pick, did not lose myself.
